blocks.text: OLONGAPO CITY, Philippines — Sea travel for all motor bancas and other watercraft was suspended by the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) on Tuesday, Oct. 20, in Aurora province as a precaution against Super Typhoon Rosal (international name: Champi). The PCG Coast Guard Station Aurora, in a sea travel advisory, ordered the temporary suspension to prevent maritime accidents and protect the lives of fishermen, passengers and crew members. Fishermen and vessel operators were advised not to venture out to sea while the suspension remains in effect and to follow official advisories and instructions from the Coast Guard and the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical […]...
